## PAQUETES Y DATOS
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(stringi)
```


```{r}
path_int = "../data/internet_users_world_wide.csv"
internet = read_csv(path_int)

path_met = "../data/metadata_countries_internet_users.csv"
metadata = read_csv(path_met)
```

## NORMALIZAR DATOS
```{r}
#Funcion para normalizar los datos
funcion_df = function(dataframe, clean = TRUE, which_remove = "cols") {
  if (clean) {
    data_clean = clean_names(dataframe)
  } else {
    data_clean = dataframe
  }
  
  if (which_remove == "both") {
    data_clean = data_clean |> 
      janitor::remove_empty(which = 'cols') %>% 
      janitor::remove_empty(which = 'rows')
  } else {
    data_clean = janitor::remove_empty(data_clean, which = which_remove)
  }
  
  return(data_clean)
}

funcion_df(internet, clean = FALSE, which_remove = 'both')
```

```{r}
#Normalizar datos
internet <- funcion_df(internet)
metadata <- funcion_df(metadata)
```
